notes: Read all 80 source lines (numbered) before editing. This is the first shared/ widget primitive in the native tree; it is a self-contained reusable component (no API hooks, no i18n runtime calls, no DOM), so it ports cleanly to react-native primitives.

L1 `import { type ReactNode } from 'react'` -> `import React, {type ReactNode} from 'react'`: ReactNode is reused verbatim (WidgetDetailCardProps.emptyIcon); the React default import is added because the base @react-native/typescript-config sets jsx:'react-native' (classic runtime compiles JSX to React.createElement, so React must be in scope) — matching every sibling native component.

L2 `import { Badge } from '@/components/ui'` -> an inline native Badge component. The web Badge is a DOM <span> (browser-only); per the ChargeStatusWidget inline-reproduction precedent it is reproduced self-contained as a rounded pill (View + AppText), sized like the web `size="sm"` chip (px-1.5 py-0.5 -> paddingHorizontal 6 / paddingVertical 2, text-xs -> fontSize 11, rounded-full -> borderRadius 999, font-medium -> fontWeight '500').

L3 `import { EmptyState } from '@/components/feedback'` -> an inline native EmptyState (centered optional icon chip + muted message). The canonical native components/feedback EmptyState takes {title, message} with no icon slot, so the web {icon, message, className} usage is reproduced inline (same precedent as ChargeStatusWidget).

L4 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'` -> dropped: the two cn() call sites (L50-53 row divider, L60-63 mono value) become conditional StyleSheet arrays (`[styles.row, cond && styles.rowDivider]`, `[styles.value, entry.mono && styles.valueMono]`), the react-native styling idiom.

L6-11 `export interface DetailEntry { label: string; value: string | number | null; badge?: { text: string; variant: 'success'|'warning'|'error'|'neutral' }; mono?: boolean }` preserved verbatim (still exported — this is the public type other widgets consume).
L13-18 `interface WidgetDetailCardProps { entries: DetailEntry[]; compact?: boolean; emptyMessage?: string; emptyIcon?: ReactNode }` preserved verbatim.

L20-25 the `badgeVariantMap` const (success->success, warning->warning, error->danger, neutral->neutral) preserved verbatim with `as const`; a NativeBadgeVariant type derives from it so the inline Badge accepts exactly the mapped union ('success'|'warning'|'danger'|'neutral'). error->danger collapses onto the native danger token.

L27-32 `export function WidgetDetailCard({ entries, compact = false, emptyMessage, emptyIcon }: WidgetDetailCardProps)` preserved verbatim — same named export, same destructure, same `compact = false` default.

L33-41 the empty-list branch `if (entries.length === 0) return <EmptyState icon={emptyIcon} message={emptyMessage ?? 'No details available'} className="py-4" />` preserved: the web `?? 'No details available'` fallback is kept verbatim, the web py-4 maps to the inline EmptyState's paddingVertical 16, emptyIcon is forwarded to the icon slot, and the L35 no-action comment (transient empty state, no recovery action) is copied verbatim above the branch.
L43 `const visible = compact ? entries.slice(0, 4) : entries` preserved verbatim (compact caps the list at 4 rows).
L46 `<div className="overflow-y-auto h-full">` -> `<ScrollView style={styles.scroll}>` (flex:1) — the faithful native vertical scroller for a full-height detail list.

L47-54 `visible.map((entry, i) => <div key={entry.label} className={cn('flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2 px-1', i < visible.length - 1 && 'border-b border-white/[0.06]')}>` -> a View with key={entry.label} and style [styles.row, i < visible.length - 1 && styles.rowDivider]. styles.row = flexDirection row / alignItems center / justifyContent space-between / gap 12 (gap-3) / paddingVertical 8 (py-2) / paddingHorizontal 4 (px-1); styles.rowDivider = borderBottomWidth 1 / borderBottomColor 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' (border-white/[0.06]) on every row except the last — the exact index condition is preserved.

L55-57 the label `{entry.label}` -> `{entry.label}`: fontSize 10 (text-[10px]), textTransform uppercase, color colors.textMuted (--text-muted), letterSpacing 0.5 (tracking-wide), flexShrink 1 + numberOfLines 1 (min-w-0 truncate).

L58 `<span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">` -> `<View style={styles.valueGroup}>`: flexDirection row / alignItems center / gap 8 (gap-2) / flexShrink 1 (min-w-0) / justifyContent flex-end so the value+badge cluster hugs the right edge and the value can shrink/truncate.

L59-66 the value `{entry.value ?? '—'}` -> `{entry.value ?? '—'}`: fontSize 14 (text-sm), color colors.textPrimary (--text-primary), flexShrink 1 + numberOfLines 1 (truncate). entry.mono toggles styles.valueMono whose fontFamily is Platform.select({ios:'Courier', default:'monospace'}) (font-mono). The `entry.value ?? '—'` em-dash fallback is preserved verbatim (RN renders the string|number child directly; 0 stays '0', null becomes '—').

L67-74 the badge `{entry.badge && <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[entry.badge.variant]} size="sm">{entry.badge.text}</Badge>}` -> `{entry.badge && <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[entry.badge.variant]}>{entry.badge.text}</Badge>}`: the conditional, the badgeVariantMap lookup, and the badge text are preserved; size="sm" is baked into the inline native Badge's fixed sm dimensions. The four variants map onto native tokens — success: successSurface/successBorder/success, warning: warningSurface/warningBorder/warning, danger: dangerSurface/dangerBorder/danger, neutral: surfaceRaised/border/textSecondary — reproducing the web bg-{color}/text-{color} chip in the native dark palette.
L75-80 close the valueGroup View, the row View, the .map, the ScrollView, the return, and the component — preserved.

No DOM elements, no @/components/ui Badge, no @/components/feedback EmptyState, no @/lib/cn, no react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router, or old web UI components are imported into the native output — only react, react-native (ScrollView/View/StyleSheet/Platform), the canonical AppText, and theme tokens. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass.
